name: Krovavye nochi blednoj lilii
source:
The protagonist wakes up in a strange world, the guy does not remember anything but his name and at the same place sees a girl. The girl offers her help, promising the guy to get out of this universe, but who knew that this is the beginning of a tragic story...

[From [url=https://rushi13.itch.io/bloody-nights-of-pale-lilyeng]itch.io[/url]]
